name: TDI Sharkfin Reversal
description: Spot strategy based only on the original white BUY and white SELL sharkfin labels from the uploaded TDI Sharkfin and Divergence Suite. Turquoise wait crosses, divergences, Bollinger-band events, and other TDI conditions are not trade triggers.

source_indicator.name: TDI Sharkfin and Divergence Suite x

entry.condition: WHITE BUY only: fastMA[2] < 32 AND fastMA[1] > fastMA[2] AND fastMA > fastMA[1] AND fastMA < 32.
entry.action: Buy the selected spot asset with USDT on a confirmed white BUY signal.

exit.condition: WHITE SELL only: fastMA[2] > 68 AND fastMA[1] < fastMA[2] AND fastMA < fastMA[1] AND fastMA > 68.
exit.action: Sell/reduce the selected spot asset to USDT on a confirmed white SELL signal if the wallet holds the asset.

confirmation.condition: The three-bar white sharkfin label itself is the confirmation. No additional CMC, Fear & Greed, optimizer, divergence, Bollinger-band, volume, or turquoise-cross confirmation is required in Manual Override.

historical_table_measurement_only.note: These values belong to the Pine indicator's simplified historical outcome table and are not live entry/exit rules for this strategy.

risk_governor.signal_source: white BUY / white SELL labels only
